Docket No. 59475; SOAH Docket No. 473-26-16349 — Joint Application of Oncor
Electric Delivery Company LLC and LCRA Transmission Service Corporation to
Amend their Certificates of Convenience and Necessity for the Bell County East
Switch to Big Hill Substation 765-kV Transmission Line Project in Bell, Burnet,
Concho, Coryell, Lampasas, Llano, Mason, McCulloch, Menard, Milam, Mills, San
Saba, Schleicher, Tom Green, and Williamson Counties;

Project 58317 — SB 6 Implementation


 I requested this open meeting because I want to discuss policy issues with my fellow
Commissioners and ERCOT related to the development and implementation of the Permian Basin
Reliability Plan, including the three 765-kilovolt (kV) import paths required under that plan.'

Because this discussion will raise issues common to the pending 765-kV transmission line
CCN proceedings, I wanted to provide notice in each of the above-referenced dockets that we are
having this discussion. But I also want to provide clarity to all affected parties—the purpose of
this meeting is not to discuss facts or circumstances specific to any individual transmission line
proceeding. No final decisions will be made regarding any individual transmission line at this
open meeting. Before the Commission can make a final decision in each case, a proposal for
decision must properly be before the Commission for consideration at a future open meeting and
the parties in each case have an opportunity to present oral argument to the Commission.

In addition to the status of Batch 0, I would also like to hear from ERCOT on their plan for
auditing all data centers advancing through ERCOT’s interconnection process and plans for
collecting additional information as instructed in the Governor’s letter.”

T look forward to discussing this matter with you at the open meeting.
